title: Daily run 2026-11-05 (exact Nov 2-4; Nov 5 00-04 UTC from hourly data)

items: Roblox Game Join (Key 6): NEW on pragma + upcoming-Chrome, 11k Nov 3 -> 94k Nov 4 at 39% verified; 8.3k in the first 5 hours of Nov 5 (38%). Also new on ends-te + dp-spoof today (8.9k, 7%).
Adobe ARP FF (Key 8): grease and pagebio verified share climbing 30% -> 59% -> 82-88% (Nov 2-4) and 91-96% today (~15k each in 5h); OS-spoofing 33k Nov 4 at 76%, 89% today.
Uber SMS (Key 1): single-click + dp-spoof 27-33k/day at 69-85% verified (81% today). The pragma wave (127k Nov 2 at 76%, 103k Nov 3 at 91%) stopped on Nov 4.
DoorDash Website: OS-spoofing families 20-73k/day at 38-49% verified, steady.

NEW, validated, not created: g-upcoming-chrome-consecutive-sec-ch-ua-ip-intel-medium (upcoming-Chrome sec-ch-ua + consecutive sec-ch-ua + ASN medium risk). 4.84M sessions on 5 keys at 7.8% verified: Amazon IDS 4.44M growing 741k -> 1.58M/day (2%), Uber SMS 286k at 84% (ended Nov 4; its 27k NO-THREAT hits share JA4 and device id with the bot-classified ones, i.e. missed bots), Adobe Sign Up 43k (58%), MS Identity Signup 24k, Roblox Game Join 20k (33%).
On hold (looks like a client-population change, not an attack): accept-encoding-no-br + GREASE + page-bio null, 1.60M on ~16-20 keys at 70% verified; most keys verify >95%.
Last run's candidates: rfc ct-before-cl + di-short-300 still lets Uber SMS through (1.04M Nov 1-4 at 67% verified, fading 448k -> 124k/day); dp-spoof + hrsig-4x 697k at 9% verified (mostly blocked).

Artifacts dropped: new fp-touch-2-0-0 / fp-touch-1-0-0 flags (created Oct 30 / Nov 4), g-atm agent flags, cdn single-cookie, timezone family, ja4-dict-1, wired velocity, Ensemble lists, dict-7/15/31. DI revert has NOT landed; none of the CHNGE-6738 parents exist yet.

Roblox Signup (Key 2): grease/pagebio burst 381k / 367k on Nov 2 at 8% verified, down to ~1k today.

Uber SMS pragma wave (Nov 4); Highlight AI; Roblox Login webgl and dishort300 waves; Expedia Taap (0 today); Roblox Signup burst back to baseline.
